name: JellyGlance item
description: One title across Jellyfin, Seerr, Arr, and downloads. Replace ITEM_ID.

displayConfig.template:
<Stack gap="xs" p="xs" h="100%">
  <Group justify="space-between" align="center" wrap="nowrap" gap="xs" pr={36}>
    <Group gap="xs" wrap="nowrap" miw={0}>
      <Avatar src="https://jellyglance.com/project-logo.png" size={24} radius="xl" />
      <Stack gap={0} miw={0}>
        <Text fw={800} size="sm" truncate>Item glance</Text>
        <Text size="xs" c="dimmed" truncate>{data.item.library}</Text>
      </Stack>
    </Group>
    <Box style={{ flexShrink: 0 }}><Badge variant="light" color="violet">{data.item.type}</Badge></Box>
  </Group>
  <Stack gap="sm" flex={1} mih={0} style={{ overflowY: "auto" }}>
  <Card withBorder radius="md" p="sm">
    <Text fw={800}>{data.item.name}</Text>
    <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">{data.item.year}</Text>
  </Card>
  </Stack>
</Stack>
